templates.why_chosen: Two named horizontal bands bridged by an identically labelled 'Communication Interface' in each, with two colour-coded channels.
templates.what_to_learn: When two subsystems talk over a channel, draw the same interface box in both bands - the repeated label is what makes the boundary legible.
